name: Ya Devi Sarva Bhuteshu
text:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु चेतनेत्यभिधीयते ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
meaning: To the Goddess who is called consciousness in all beings: salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations again and again.
purpose: The refrain of the Devi Mahatmya, praising the Goddess present in all beings in many forms. Each form is sung in turn with the same refrain.
supports: Seeing the sacred in ordinary experience; compassion; reverence.
when: As a long recitation, one form at a time.

parts.meaning: Chetanetyabhidhiyate: the Goddess who is present as consciousness in all beings.
Buddhirupena samsthita: who resides as intellect and wisdom in all.
Nidrarupena samsthita: who resides as sleep in all beings.
Kshudharupena samsthita: who is hunger in all.
Chhayarupena samsthita: who is shadow in all.
Trishnarupena samsthita: who is thirst in all.
Jatirupena samsthita: who is birth in all.
Shraddharupena samsthita: who is faith in all.
Kantirupena samsthita: who is beauty and radiance.
Vrittirupena samsthita: who is the way we live and act.
Smritirupena samsthita: who is remembrance in all.
Matrurupena samsthita: who is mother in all beings.
Bhrantirupena samsthita: who is even delusion and illusion.
Shaktirupena samsthita: who is power and energy in all.
